name: comp-394
title: Avatar Online Status
description: A circular avatar with a small green status dot overlapping its lower-right edge. It marks a person as online; the name and Online caption beneath come from the demo.
use: A person's photo should show at a glance whether they are available right now.
avoid: The dot is colour only and very small, so it is easy to miss and hard to read for colour-blind users.
a11y: The photo has alt text and the dot hides an 'Online' label for screen readers; colour alone carries the visual status. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Centred on a near-black page is a small round portrait with a bright green dot ringed in dark at its lower-right corner. Below it sit a bold white name and a grey 'Online' label.
behaves: Static: nothing moves or responds. The green dot simply shows an online state.
customise: The photo URL, alt text, KK fallback and the green dot colour are fixed in the file; a different status needs a source edit.
weight: light: One image and one small dot; nothing animates.
